questions.question: If (x - 2y)2 + (2y - 3z)2 = 0, what is the value of (x + y + z)2/(x - y − z)2?
questions.question_hi: यदि (x - 2y)2 + (2y - 3z)2 = 0 है, तो (x + y + z)2/(x - y − z)2 का मान कितना है?
questions.solution:
(x - 2y)2 + (2y - 3z)2 = 0

When sum of squares is zero, each term has to be equal to zero since there cannot be a negative term in there.

∴ x = 2y and 2y = 3z

Let x = 2y = 3z = 6k

=> y = 3k and z = 2k

∴ (x + y + z)2/(x - y − z)2

= (6k + 3k + 2k)2/(6k - 3k - 2k)2

= 121k2/k2

= 121

questions.solution:
Let's assume sheep = x

Chicken = 2x

Heads = x + 2x = 3x

Feet = (x * 4) + (2x * 2)

= 8x

Total 3x + 8x = 99

x = 99/11= 9

Hence the correct answer is option A.

questions.question: Suppose 40% of students study Mathematics, 25% of students study Physics, and 20% of the students who study Mathematics also study Physics. If a student is chosen at random and is found to study Physics, what is the probability that the student also studies Mathematics?
questions.question_hi: मान लीजिए कि 40% छात्र गणित पढ़ते हैं, 25% छात्र भौतिक विज्ञान पढ़ते हैं, और गणित पढ़ने वाले 20% छात्र भौतिक विज्ञान भी पढ़ते हैं। यदि किसी छात्र को यादृच्छिक रूप से चुना जाता है और वह भौतिक विज्ञान पढ़ता है, तो इस बात की क्या प्रायिकता है कि वह छात्र गणित भी पढ़ता है?
questions.solution:
Let M be the event that a student studies Mathematics and P be the event that a student studies Physics.

Given that P(M) = 0.40, P(P) = 0.25 and P(P | M) = 0.20.

We are required to find P(M | P).

Using the formula of conditional probability,

P(M | P) = P(M ∩ P) / P(P)

Now,

P(M ∩ P) = P(P | M) × P(M)

= 0.20 × 0.40

= 0.08

Therefore,

P(M | P) = 0.08 / 0.25 = 0.32

Hence, the required probability is 0.32 or 32%

questions.question: Two workers A and B can finish a work alone in 15 days and 20 days respectively. A and B together worked for 6 days and then C completed the remaining work with B in 18 hours. In how much time C alone can finish the complete work?
questions.question_hi: दो कर्मचारी A और B अकेले एक कार्य को क्रमशः 15 दिन और 20 दिन में पूरा कर सकते हैं। एक साथ A और B ने 6 दिनों तक कार्य किया और फिर C ने B के साथ शेष कार्य को 18 घंटे में पूरा किया। C अकेले सम्पूर्ण कार्य को कितने समय में पूरा कर सकता है?
questions.solution:
A = 15 days, B = 20 days

6 days' work done by A and B together = 6 * (1/15 + 1/20)

= 7/10

Remaining work = 1 - 7/10 = 3/10

Now, 18 hours = (18/24) day = (3/4) day

B and C together completed 3/10th part of the work in 3/4 day. So,

(3/4) * (1/B + 1/C) = 3/10

(3/4) * (1/20 + 1/C) = 3/10

1/20 + 1/C = 2/5

C = 20/7

C = 2(6/7) days

How many of the following pairs consist of two palindromic numbers whose difference is also a palindrome?

Pairs:

III. (34343, 20202)

A palindrome number is a number that reads the same both forwards and backwards.

I. Reverse of 12721 => 12721, Reverse of 10101 => 10101

III. Reverse of 34343 => 34343 (same), Reverse of 20202 => 20202 (same)

Difference = 34343 - 20202 = 14141

Reverse of 14141 = 14141 (same)

IV. Reverse of 65656 => 65656 (same), Reverse of 33933 => 33933 (same)

Difference = 65656 - 33933 = 31723

Reverse of 31723 = 32713 (differ)

Hence, option 'c' is correct.

questions.passage:
Directions : Study the passage below and answer the questions that follow.

Volcanic activity is a constant global threat. It's estimated over 1 billion people live within the potential, direct impact range of volcanic eruptions. Just recently, lava flows from the eruption of Mount Nyiragongo, a volcano in the Democratic Republic of Congo, killed 32 people, with many more missing. Tens of thousands of people have been forced to flee the city of Goma. This shows why understanding more about the inner workings of volcanoes is critical to improve the safety of those living in their shadows. As a volcano scientist, I take a microscopic look at volcanic rocks and fragments of the Earth's mantle to estimate just how fast molten rock (magma) moves from deep in the Earth to the surface. This can help us prepare for future eruptions.

Since the demise of the dinosaurs to recent human settlement, magmatic activity has left behind a trail of volcanoes stretching over 4,000 kilometres down Australia's eastern margin, forming one of the world's most extensive volcanic belts. The last mainland eruptions took place at Mount Gambier and Mount Schank in South Australia around 5,000 years ago, a mere blink of a geological eye. These eruptions were witnessed by local Aboriginal people and incorporated into oral traditions that have been passed down for hundreds of generations. Based on the time since the last eruption, there are potentially two active volcanic regions in mainland Australia: in the northeast (southwest of Cairns) and southeast (from Melbourne across into South Australia). The Mount Gambier and Mount Schank volcanoes are two of more than 400 volcanoes in the active southeast region called the Newer Volcanics Province, which has been active for at least the last 4.5 million years. It's considered likely there'll be a future eruption in this province, but it's not known when or where exactly the eruption will be.

To answer many mysterious questions, we have to unravel the secrets held by past eruptions, now locked away in the erupted rocks and the crystals within them. Our first clue is that many of the dark black volcanic rocks that erupted in the Newer Volcanics Province (and others) contain chunks of green rock, called peridotite. These dense green rock fragments are, in fact, pieces of the Earth's upper mantle that were plucked out by the rising magma and carried all the way to the surface from depths of greater than 30 or 40 kilometres below our feet. These fragments can sink back down through the liquid rock during its ascent, like a pebble dropped into a cylinder of honey. So in order to reach the surface, the rising magma had to move fast - likely taking just a few days from the source.

options.label: B

questions.solution:
Options (a) and (b) both are correct. Refer to the last two sentences of the first paragraph where it is clearly mentioned that the author studied volcanic rocks and fragments of the Earth's mantle to be able to prevent or safeguard people and property from volcanoes by knowing how much time volcanoes take to erupt.

Hence, option (c) is correct.

Directions : Study the passage below and answer the questions that follow.

Volcanic activity is a constant global threat. It's estimated over 1 billion people live within the potential, direct impact range of volcanic eruptions. Just recently, lava flows from the eruption of Mount Nyiragongo, a volcano in the Democratic Republic of Congo, killed 32 people, with many more missing. Tens of thousands of people have been forced to flee the city of Goma. This shows why understanding more about the inner workings of volcanoes is critical to improve the safety of those living in their shadows. As a volcano scientist, I take a microscopic look at volcanic rocks and fragments of the Earth's mantle to estimate just how fast molten rock (magma) moves from deep in the Earth to the surface. This can help us prepare for future eruptions.

Since the demise of the dinosaurs to recent human settlement, magmatic activity has left behind a trail of volcanoes stretching over 4,000 kilometres down Australia's eastern margin, forming one of the world's most extensive volcanic belts. The last mainland eruptions took place at Mount Gambier and Mount Schank in South Australia around 5,000 years ago, a mere blink of a geological eye. These eruptions were witnessed by local Aboriginal people and incorporated into oral traditions that have been passed down for hundreds of generations. Based on the time since the last eruption, there are potentially two active volcanic regions in mainland Australia: in the northeast (southwest of Cairns) and southeast (from Melbourne across into South Australia). The Mount Gambier and Mount Schank volcanoes are two of more than 400 volcanoes in the active southeast region called the Newer Volcanics Province, which has been active for at least the last 4.5 million years. It's considered likely there'll be a future eruption in this province, but it's not known when or where exactly the eruption will be.

To answer many mysterious questions, we have to unravel the secrets held by past eruptions, now locked away in the erupted rocks and the crystals within them. Our first clue is that many of the dark black volcanic rocks that erupted in the Newer Volcanics Province (and others) contain chunks of green rock, called peridotite. These dense green rock fragments are, in fact, pieces of the Earth's upper mantle that were plucked out by the rising magma and carried all the way to the surface from depths of greater than 30 or 40 kilometres below our feet. These fragments can sink back down through the liquid rock during its ascent, like a pebble dropped into a cylinder of honey. So in order to reach the surface, the rising magma had to move fast - likely taking just a few days from the source.

questions.solution: The Supreme Court on March 24, 2026 held in a judgment that a person professing any religion other than Hinduism, Buddhism, or Sikhism should not be considered a member of a Schedule Caste community. The court concluded that conversion to any other religion would result in 'immediate and complete loss of Scheduled Caste status from the moment of conversion, regardless of birth'. A Bench of Justices Prashant Kumar Mishra and Manmohan invoked Clause 3 of the Constitution (Scheduled Castes) Order, 1950, which mandates that 'no person who professes a religion different from Hinduism shall be deemed to be a member of a Scheduled Caste'. The Sikh religion was added to the ambit of Clause 3 in 1956. The provision was further amended in 1990 to include persons professing Buddhism. The judgment also dealt with the Constitution (Scheduled Tribes) Order, 1950, which did not prescribe religion-based exclusion as in the case of the Scheduled Caste community. Justice Mishra said a person could claim benefits under the Constitution (Scheduled Tribes) Order, 1950, only if he or she continued to belong to that particular tribe 'in substance'.

questions.solution:
Under Article 254 of the Constitution, in case of a conflict between a Central law and a State law on a Concurrent List subject, the Central law generally prevails.

However, if the State law has been reserved for the consideration of the President and receives the President's assent, it prevails within that State.

Parliament, however, retains the power to override such a State law later by enacting another law on the same subject.

Option (b):

Normally, the Central law prevails over a conflicting State law on a Concurrent List subject unless the State law has received the President's assent under Article 254(2).

Option (c):

Parliament has exclusive authority over residuary subjects, whereas both Parliament and State Legislatures legislate on Concurrent List subjects.

Option (d):

The 42nd Constitutional Amendment shifted Education and Forests from the State List to the Concurrent List.

Further Insights:

• The Seventh Schedule divides legislative subjects into the Union List, State List and Concurrent List.

• Residuary powers are vested in the Union Parliament under Article 248 (borrowed from the Canadian Constitution).

questions.question: Which group of plants is characterised by the presence of vascular tissues but absence of seeds?
questions.question_hi: पौधों का कौन सा समूह संवहनी ऊतकों की उपस्थिति लेकिन बीजों की अनुपस्थिति से पहचाना जाता है?
questions.solution:
In the plant kingdom, plants are classified based on the presence of vascular tissue (Xylem and Phloem) and their method of reproduction (seeds vs. spores).

Pteridophytes (such as ferns, horsetails, and lycophytes) represent an evolutionary milestone. They are known as "Vascular Cryptogams" because:

-Vascular Tissues: They possess specialized tissues (Xylem to transport water and Phloem to transport food), which allow them to grow much taller than mosses.

-Absence of Seeds: They do not produce flowers or seeds. Instead, they reproduce via spores, which are usually found on the underside of their leaves (fronds).

The other options are incorrect:

Bryophytes (e.g., Mosses): These are the "amphibians of the plant kingdom." They lack both seeds and true vascular tissues. They rely on simple diffusion to move water.

Gymnosperms (e.g., Pine, Cycas): These plants have vascular tissues and produce seeds. However, their seeds are "naked" (not enclosed in a fruit).

Angiosperms (e.g., Mango, Rose): These are the most advanced plants. They have vascular tissues, produce seeds, and their seeds are enclosed within fruits (flowering plants).

questions.question:
With reference to the Fundamental Rights enshrined in Part III of the Constitution of India, consider the following statements:

i) Part III of the Indian Constitution was inspired by the Bill of Rights of the USA and is referred to as the "Magna Carta of India."

ii) Article 21A was added by the 86th Constitutional Amendment Act (2002) to make free and compulsory education a fundamental right for children aged 6 to 14.

iii) Dr. B.R. Ambedkar described Article 32 (Right to Constitutional Remedies) as the "Heart and Soul of the Constitution."

iv) During a National Emergency, all Fundamental Rights are automatically suspended, including those under Articles 20 and 21.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत के संविधान के भाग III में निहित मौलिक अधिकारों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) भारतीय संविधान का भाग III संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका के बिल ऑफ राइट्स से प्रेरित था और इसे "भारत का मैग्ना कार्टा" कहा जाता है।

ii) 6 से 14 वर्ष की आयु के बच्चों के लिए मुफ्त और अनिवार्य शिक्षा को मौलिक अधिकार बनाने के लिए 86वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम (2002) द्वारा अनुच्छेद 21A जोड़ा गया था।

iii) डॉ. बी.आर. अंबेडकर ने अनुच्छेद 32 (संवैधानिक उपचारों का अधिकार) को "संविधान का हृदय और आत्मा" बताया था।

iv) राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल के दौरान, अनुच्छेद 20 और 21 के तहत अधिकारों सहित सभी मौलिक अधिकार स्वतः निलंबित हो जाते हैं।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement i is correct:

Part III of the Constitution deals with Fundamental Rights. The Fundamental Rights are generally regarded as an important constitutional safeguard for individual liberty and are often described as the "Magna Carta" of the Constitution. The idea of Fundamental Rights in the Indian Constitution was influenced by the US Bill of Rights.

Statement ii is correct:

Article 21A was inserted through the Constitution (86th Amendment) Act, 2002. It provides for free and compulsory education for all children between 6 and 14 years of age.

Statement iii is correct:

Dr. B.R. Ambedkar described Article 32 as the "heart and soul" of the Constitution because it provides a constitutional remedy for the enforcement of Fundamental Rights.

Statement iv is incorrect:

Fundamental Rights are not automatically suspended in their entirety during every National Emergency. Article 359 permits the President, subject to the constitutional provisions, to suspend the right to move courts for enforcement of specified Fundamental Rights, but Articles 20 and 21 are specifically excluded from such an order. Article 358 separately deals with Article 19 and applies only to emergencies based on war or external aggression.

questions.solution:
Most of the Himalayan rivers are perennial. It means that they have water throughout the year. These rivers receive water from rain as well as from melted snow from the lofty mountains.

Further Insight:

Features of Himalayan River

1. Origin Himalayan rivers originate from glaciers and snowfields of the Himalayas (e.g., Ganga, Yamuna, Brahmaputra).

2. Perennial Flow They are perennial rivers, carrying water throughout the year due to melting snow and rainfall.

3. Long Courses They have long courses, starting from the mountains and flowing across the plains to the sea.

4. Steep Gradient Himalayan rivers have a steep gradient, causing fast flow, rapids, and waterfalls in the upper course.

5. V-Shaped Valleys They form V-shaped valleys and deep gorges in the mountains due to strong vertical erosion.

6. Braided Channels Rivers often form braided channels in the middle course due to heavy sediment load.

7. Large Drainage Basin They have extensive drainage basins, supporting agriculture and settlements downstream.

8. High Erosive Power Strong current and sediment load give them high erosive and transport capacity.

9. Formation of Deltas Some Himalayan rivers, like the Ganga and Brahmaputra, form large alluvial plains and deltas at the mouth.

questions.question:
In the context of international Track and Field (Athletics) regulations governed by World Athletics, consider the following statements regarding the technical execution of a valid Long Jump:

1. A jump is declared a foul if any part of the athlete's take-off shoe or foot breaks the vertical plane of the take-off line (advancing past the front edge of the take-off board), regardless of whether it touches the plasticine indicator board.

2. The distance of the jump is measured from the front edge of the take-off board to the very first point of contact made by any part of the athlete's body or limbs in the landing pit.

3. If an athlete somersaults or flips forward through the air during the flight phase, the jump is automatically disqualified.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
विश्व एथलेटिक्स द्वारा नियंत्रित अंतरराष्ट्रीय ट्रैक और फील्ड (एथलेटिक्स) नियमों के संदर्भ में, एक वैध लॉन्ग जंप के तकनीकी निष्पादन के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. यदि एथलीट के टेक-ऑफ जूते या पैर का कोई भी हिस्सा टेक-ऑफ लाइन के लंबवत तल को तोड़ता है (टेक-ऑफ बोर्ड के सामने के किनारे से आगे बढ़ता है), चाहे वह प्लास्टिसिन इंडिकेटर बोर्ड को छूता हो या नहीं, तो जंप को फाउल घोषित किया जाता है।

2. जंप की दूरी टेक-ऑफ बोर्ड के सामने के किनारे से मापी जाती है, जो लैंडिंग पिट में एथलीट के शरीर या अंगों के किसी भी हिस्से द्वारा पहली संपर्क बिंदु तक होती है।

3. यदि एथलीट उड़ान चरण के दौरान हवा में समरसॉल्ट या आगे की ओर पलटता है, तो जंप स्वचालित रूप से अयोग्य घोषित हो जाता है।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: Under the updated World Athletics technical rules (the "take-off foul rule"), a foul is redefined strictly by whether any part of the athletes foot or shoe breaks the vertical plane of the take-off line. This replaced the older rule that required an actual physical footprint to be left in the plasticine.

Statement 2 is incorrect: The distance is measured from the edge of the take-off board to the nearest break in the landing area (the sand pit) made by any part of the body, which means it is measured to the mark closest to the take-off board (usually where the hands, heels, or rear slips), not the first point of contact.

Statement 3 is correct: World Athletics explicitly bans the use of somersaults (such as the historical "flip" technique) during the take-off or flight phases of the long jump due to extreme safety risks to the athlete's spine and neck.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the Law of Demand:

1) The Law of Demand states that, all else being equal, an increase in the price of a good leads to a decrease in its quantity demanded - establishing an inverse relationship between price and demand.

2) Giffen goods are an exception to the Law of Demand - they are inferior goods for which demand increases as price rises, because the income effect outweighs the substitution effect.

3) Veblen goods, such as luxury cars and designer goods, violate the Law of Demand because they are purchased precisely for their high price - which signals social status - so demand rises with price.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
माँग के नियम के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) माँग का नियम बताता है कि, अन्य बातें समान रहने पर, किसी वस्तु की कीमत में वृद्धि से उसकी माँगी गई मात्रा में कमी आती है - जो कीमत और माँग के बीच एक व्युत्क्रमानुपाती संबंध स्थापित करता है।

2) गिफिन वस्तुएँ माँग के नियम का अपवाद हैं - ये ऐसी निम्न कोटि की वस्तुएँ हैं जिनकी कीमत बढ़ने पर माँग बढ़ती है, क्योंकि आय प्रभाव प्रतिस्थापन प्रभाव से अधिक हो जाता है।

3) वेब्लेन वस्तुएँ, जैसे लक्जरी कारें और डिज़ाइनर वस्तुएँ, माँग के नियम का उल्लंघन करती हैं क्योंकि उन्हें विशेष रूप से उनकी उच्च कीमत के लिए खरीदा जाता है - जो सामाजिक स्थिति को दर्शाता है - इसलिए कीमत के साथ माँग बढ़ती है।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: The Law of Demand (formulated by Alfred Marshall) describes the fundamental inverse price-demand relationship - ceteris paribus (all other factors constant). This is represented by a downward-sloping demand curve.

Statement 2 is correct: Giffen goods are a paradox within inferior goods. For a Giffen good, the income effect (the consumer feels poorer and buys more of the inferior staple) dominates the substitution effect (the tendency to switch to cheaper alternatives). Sir Robert Giffen observed this with bread among the poor in 19th-century England. Example in India: coarse grains in low-income households.

Statement 3 is correct: Veblen goods (named after economist Thorstein Veblen) are luxury goods whose demand increases with price because consumers use them for conspicuous consumption - signalling wealth and social status. The high price itself is part of the appeal. Examples include luxury watches, designer handbags, and premium cars.

Further Insights:

Other exceptions to the Law of Demand include: speculative goods (people buy more when prices rise expecting further rises - e.g., gold, real estate during booms), essential medicines (demand is largely price-inelastic), and commodities in anticipation of future shortages.

Hindi:

कथन 1 सही है: माँग का नियम (अल्फ्रेड मार्शल द्वारा प्रतिपादित) मौलिक व्युत्क्रमानुपाती कीमत-माँग संबंध का वर्णन करता है - सेटेरिस पारिबस (अन्य सभी कारक स्थिर)। इसे नीचे की ओर ढलान वाले माँग वक्र द्वारा दर्शाया जाता है।

कथन 2 सही है: गिफिन वस्तुएँ निम्न कोटि की वस्तुओं के भीतर एक विरोधाभास हैं। गिफिन वस्तु के लिए, आय प्रभाव (उपभोक्ता गरीब महसूस करता है और निम्न कोटि के मुख्य भोजन को अधिक खरीदता है) प्रतिस्थापन प्रभाव (सस्ते विकल्पों पर स्विच करने की प्रवृत्ति) पर हावी होता है। सर रॉबर्ट गिफिन ने 19वीं सदी के इंग्लैंड में गरीबों के बीच ब्रेड के साथ यह देखा था। भारत में उदाहरण: कम आय वाले परिवारों में मोटे अनाज।

कथन 3 सही है: वेब्लेन वस्तुएँ (अर्थशास्त्री थोरस्टीन वेब्लेन के नाम पर) ऐसी लक्जरी वस्तुएँ हैं जिनकी माँग कीमत के साथ बढ़ती है क्योंकि उपभोक्ता उनका उपयोग विशिष्ट उपभोग के लिए करते हैं - जो धन और सामाजिक स्थिति को दर्शाता है। उच्च कीमत अपने आप में आकर्षण का हिस्सा है। उदाहरणों में लक्जरी घड़ियाँ, डिज़ाइनर हैंडबैग और प्रीमियम कारें शामिल हैं।

अन्य तथ्य:

माँग के नियम के अन्य अपवादों में शामिल हैं: सट्टा वस्तुएँ (लोग कीमतें बढ़ने पर और वृद्धि की उम्मीद में अधिक खरीदते हैं - उदा., उछाल के दौरान सोना, रियल एस्टेट), आवश्यक दवाएँ (माँग काफी हद तक कीमत-बेलोचदार होती है), और भविष्य में कमी की आशंका वाली वस्तुएँ।

questions.question:
Read the following statements and choose the correct option:

Assertion (A): A diamond sparkles with immense brilliance when cut properly and exposed to directional ambient light.

Reason (R): The critical angle for a diamond-air interface is exceptionally large, causing almost all light entering it to pass straight through without internal reflections.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़ें और सही विकल्प चुनें:

दावा (A): एक हीरा जब सही ढंग से काटा जाता है और दिशात्मक परिवेशी प्रकाश के संपर्क में आता है तो अत्यधिक चमक के साथ चमकता है।

कारण (R): हीरा-हवा इंटरफेस के लिए क्रिटिकल एंगल असाधारण रूप से बड़ा होता है, जिससे उसमें प्रवेश करने वाली लगभग सारी रोशनी बिना आंतरिक परावर्तन के सीधे गुजर जाती है।

options.label: A
options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.text_hi: दोनों A और R सही हैं, और R, A की सही व्याख्या है।

options.label: B
options.text: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
options.text_hi: दोनों A और R सही हैं, लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options.label: C
options.text: A is true, but R is false.
options.text_hi: A सही है, लेकिन R गलत है।

options.label: D
options.text: A is false, but R is true.
options.text_hi: A गलत है, लेकिन R सही है।

questions.correct_text: A is true, but R is false.
questions.solution:
The sparkle is due to Total Internal Reflection (TIR). Diamond has a high refractive index (n≈2.42), meaning its critical angle is actually exceptionally small (approx 24.4 degrees).

This small angle causes light entering the diamond to get trapped and internally reflect multiple times before exiting, making the Reason false.

questions.solution:
· 'Panchayats' were given constitutional status by 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992.

· The 73th Amendment envisages the Gram Sabha as the foundation of the Panchayat Raj System to perform functions and powers entrusted to it by the State Legislatures.

· The Balwant Rai Mehta committee (1957) had recommended the establishment of the scheme of 'democratic decentralisation' which finally came to be known as Panchayati Raj.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding historic firsts in sports:

i) K.D. Jadhav became the first individual Olympic medalist of independent India by winning a bronze medal in wrestling at the 1952 Helsinki Olympics.

ii) Karnam Malleswari became the first Indian woman to win an Olympic medal when she secured a bronze in weightlifting at the 2000 Sydney Olympics.

iii) Sachin Tendulkar was the first player in international cricket history to score a double century in One Day Internationals (ODIs).

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
खेलों में ऐतिहासिक प्रथम घटनाओं के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) के.डी. जाधव 1952 के हेलसिंकी ओलंपिक में कुश्ती में कांस्य पदक जीतकर स्वतंत्र भारत के पहले व्यक्तिगत ओलंपिक पदक विजेता बने।

ii) कर्णम मल्लेश्वरी ओलंपिक पदक जीतने वाली पहली भारतीय महिला बनीं जब उन्होंने 2000 के सिडनी ओलंपिक में भारोत्तोलन में कांस्य पदक हासिल किया।

iii) सचिन तेंदुलकर एक दिवसीय अंतर्राष्ट्रीय (ODI) में दोहरा शतक बनाने वाले अंतर्राष्ट्रीय क्रिकेट इतिहास के पहले खिलाड़ी थे।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement (i) is correct

K.D. Jadhav won the bronze medal in freestyle wrestling at the 1952 Helsinki Olympics, becoming the first individual Olympic medalist of independent India.

Statement (ii) is correct

Karnam Malleswari won the bronze medal in the women's 69 kg weightlifting event at the 2000 Sydney Olympics, becoming the first Indian woman to win an Olympic medal.

Statement (iii) is correct

Sachin Tendulkar became the first cricketer in international ODI history to score a double century, remaining unbeaten on 200 against South Africa at Gwalior on 24 February 2010.

Further Insights:

• Abhinav Bindra became the first Indian to win an individual Olympic gold medal at the 2008 Beijing Olympics.

के.डी. जाधव ने 1952 के हेलसिंकी ओलंपिक में फ्रीस्टाइल कुश्ती में कांस्य पदक जीता, जिससे वे स्वतंत्र भारत के पहले व्यक्तिगत ओलंपिक पदक विजेता बन गए।

questions.question: With reference to the codification of criminal law under British administration, which of the following statements best explains the primary objective behind the enactment of the Indian Penal Code (IPC) in 1860?
questions.question_hi: ब्रिटिश प्रशासन के तहत आपराधिक कानून के संहिताकरण के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन 1860 में भारतीय दंड संहिता (IPC) के अधिनियमन के पीछे मुख्य उद्देश्य को सबसे अच्छी तरह से समझाता है?

options.label: A
options.text: To replace British statutory jurisdiction with traditional Hindu and Islamic legal frameworks across presidency towns.
options.text_hi: ब्रिटिश सांविधिक क्षेत्राधिकार को प्रेसिडेंसी शहरों में पारंपरिक हिंदू और इस्लामी कानूनी ढांचों से बदलना।

options.label: B
options.text: To establish an absolute legal distinction between European subjects and native populations regarding criminal liability.
options.text_hi: अपराधी जिम्मेदारी के संबंध में यूरोपीय विषयों और स्थानीय आबादी के बीच पूर्ण कानूनी भेद स्थापित करना।

options.label: C
options.text: To codify and standardize criminal law across British India, replacing a patchwork of diverse regional regulations and personal laws.
options.text_hi: ब्रिटिश भारत में आपराधिक कानून को संहिताबद्ध और मानकीकृत करना, विभिन्न क्षेत्रीय नियमों और व्यक्तिगत कानूनों के मिश्रण को बदलना।

options.label: D
options.text: To decentralize judicial powers, giving village councils complete autonomy over felony trials.
options.text_hi: न्यायिक शक्तियों का विकेंद्रीकरण करना, गांव की परिषदों को अपराध परीक्षणों पर पूर्ण स्वायत्तता देना।

questions.correct_text: To codify and standardize criminal law across British India, replacing a patchwork of diverse regional regulations and personal laws.
questions.solution:
Option (c) is correct: The IPC of 1860 aimed to provide a unified, clear criminal code for all of British India, replacing the varied systems that existed under different regional regulations.

Options (a), (b), and (d) are incorrect: The code aimed to unify laws under British legal philosophy rather than reinforce personal laws or grant local autonomy.

Further insights:

The first draft of the IPC was prepared by the First Law Commission in 1834, chaired by Thomas Babington Macaulay.

questions.question: Which of the following is a prominent traditional festival celebrated by the Khasi tribe in Meghalaya, primarily as a thanksgiving for a good harvest and featuring ceremonial dances?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा मेघालय में खासी जनजाति द्वारा मनाया जाने वाला एक प्रमुख पारंपरिक त्योहार है, जो मुख्य रूप से अच्छी फसल के लिए धन्यवाद के रूप में मनाया जाता है और जिसमें औपचारिक नृत्य शामिल होते हैं?
questions.solution:
Shad Nongkrem (also known as Nongkrem Dance Festival) is one of the most important festivals of the Khasi tribe in Meghalaya, celebrated annually in November in Smit village near Shillong.

It is a five-day event dedicated to offering thanks to the deity Shillong for a bountiful harvest, involving rituals like animal sacrifice, traditional dances by young men and women (including the Shad Mastieh by men with swords and Shad Kynthei by virgin women in colorful attire), and prayers for prosperity.

questions.question:
With reference to the Preamble of the Indian Constitution, consider the following statements:

1) The Preamble is based on the 'Objectives Resolution' drafted and moved by Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru in the Constituent Assembly.

2) The words 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity' were added to the Preamble by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976.

3) In the Kesavananda Bharati case (1973), the Supreme Court ruled that the Preamble is an integral part of the Constitution and can be amended under Article 368 without altering its basic structure.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारतीय संविधान की प्रस्तावना के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) प्रस्तावना संविधान सभा में पंडित जवाहरलाल नेहरू द्वारा तैयार और प्रस्तुत किए गए 'उद्देश्य प्रस्ताव' पर आधारित है।

2) 42वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 1976 द्वारा प्रस्तावना में 'समाजवादी', 'पंथनिरपेक्ष' और 'अखंडता' शब्द जोड़े गए थे।

3) केशवानंद भारती मामले (1973) में, सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने फैसला सुनाया कि प्रस्तावना संविधान का एक अभिन्न अंग है और इसके मूल ढांचे में बदलाव किए बिना अनुच्छेद 368 के तहत इसमें संशोधन किया जा सकता है।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: The Preamble embodies the core values outlined in the historic Objectives Resolution introduced by Nehru on December 13, 1946.

Statement 2 is correct: The 42nd Amendment added the three terms: "Socialist", "Secular", and "Integrity".

Statement 3 is correct: Overturning the Berubari Union judgment (1960), the Supreme Court in 1973 held that the Preamble is part of the Constitution and amendable under Article 368 as long as basic features are preserved.

Further insights:

Though part of the Constitution, the Preamble is neither a source of power to the legislature nor a prohibition upon legislative powers, and its provisions are non-justiciable in courts.

Hindi:

कथन 2 सही है: 42वें संशोधन ने तीन शब्द जोड़े: "समाजवादी", "पंथनिरपेक्ष", और "अखंडता"।

कथन 3 सही है: बेरुबारी यूनियन फैसले (1960) को पलटते हुए, सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने 1973 में माना कि प्रस्तावना संविधान का हिस्सा है और अनुच्छेद 368 के तहत संशोधन योग्य है, बशर्ते कि मूल विशेषताएं संरक्षित रहें।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding cellular respiration in human skeletal muscle tissue:

1) During strenuous physical exercise when oxygen supply is insufficient, pyruvate is converted into lactic acid in the cytoplasm.

2) Lactic acid fermentation generates 36 molecules of ATP per glucose molecule consumed.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
मानव कंकाल पेशी ऊतक में कोशिकीय श्वसन के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) कठिन शारीरिक व्यायाम के दौरान जब ऑक्सीजन की आपूर्ति अपर्याप्त होती है, तो कोशिका द्रव्य (cytoplasm) में पाइरूवेट लैक्टिक एसिड में परिवर्तित हो जाता है।

2) लैक्टिक एसिड किण्वन (fermentation) खपत किए गए प्रति ग्लूकोज अणु पर ATP के 36 अणु उत्पन्न करता है।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: Under anaerobic conditions, pyruvate acts as an electron acceptor and undergoes reduction by lactate dehydrogenase into lactic acid to regenerate NAD+ for glycolysis.

Statement 2 is incorrect: Anaerobic lactic acid fermentation produces a net gain of only 2 ATP molecules per glucose (from glycolysis). In contrast, aerobic respiration produces approximately 30 - 32 ATP molecules per glucose in eukaryotic cells.

Further insights:

The accumulated lactic acid travels via the bloodstream to the liver, where it is converted back into glucose via gluconeogenesis (the Cori Cycle).

Hindi:

कथन 1 सही है: अवायवीय (anaerobic) स्थितियों में, पाइरूवेट एक इलेक्ट्रॉन स्वीकर्ता के रूप में कार्य करता है और ग्लाइकोलाइसिस के लिए NAD+ को पुनर्जीवित करने के लिए लैक्टेट डिहाइड्रोजनेज द्वारा लैक्टिक एसिड में अपचयित (reduction) हो जाता है।

कथन 2 गलत है: अवायवीय लैक्टिक एसिड किण्वन प्रति ग्लूकोज (ग्लाइकोलाइसिस से) केवल 2 ATP अणुओं का शुद्ध लाभ उत्पन्न करता है। इसके विपरीत, वायवीय श्वसन (aerobic respiration) यूकेरियोटिक कोशिकाओं में प्रति ग्लूकोज लगभग 30-32 ATP अणु उत्पन्न करता है।

Further insights:

संचित लैक्टिक एसिड रक्तप्रवाह के माध्यम से यकृत (liver) तक जाता है, जहाँ इसे ग्लूकोनियोजेनेसिस (कोरी चक्र) के माध्यम से वापस ग्लूकोज में परिवर्तित कर दिया जाता है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the behavior, management, and properties of an operating system's Virtual Memory configuration:

I. Virtual memory extends the system's available memory space by creating a hidden file or partition on the secondary storage drive (such as a pagefile or swap space).

II. A Page Fault is an operating system alert that triggers a fatal hardware crash whenever a physical RAM stick fails its POST initialization checks.

III. Excessive swapping of memory segments back and forth between physical RAM and slow secondary disk storage can lead to a performance trap called Thrashing.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम के वर्चुअल मेमोरी कॉन्फ़िगरेशन के व्यवहार, प्रबंधन और गुणों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. वर्चुअल मेमोरी सेकेंडरी स्टोरेज ड्राइव (जैसे पेजफाइल या स्वैप स्पेस) पर एक छिपी हुई फ़ाइल या विभाजन बनाकर सिस्टम के उपलब्ध मेमोरी स्पेस का विस्तार करती है।

II. पेज फॉल्ट (Page Fault) एक ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम अलर्ट है जो जब भी कोई भौतिक RAM स्टिक अपने POST इनिशियलाइज़ेशन चेक में विफल हो जाती है, तो एक घातक हार्डवेयर क्रैश को ट्रिगर करता है।

USB is designed for general purpose peripheral connectivity, not specifically for internal drive connections.

I. सममित एन्क्रिप्शन (Symmetric Encryption) मॉडल एक समान साझा निजी कुंजी कॉन्फ़िगरेशन तैनात करते हैं जिसे ट्रैफ़िक को एन्क्रिप्ट और डिक्रिप्ट करने के लिए प्रेषक और प्राप्तकर्ता दोनों के बीच पूरी तरह से सुरक्षित रहना चाहिए।

III. डिजिटल हस्ताक्षर (Digital Signatures) डेटा पेलोड अखंडता और पूर्ण गैर-अस्वीकरण (non-repudiation) की गारंटी देने के लिए प्रेषक द्वारा अपनी स्वयं की सार्वजनिक कुंजी के साथ संदेश हैश को एन्क्रिप्ट करने पर निर्भर करते हैं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) reference model:

1) The Data Link Layer is responsible for bit-by-bit transmission over a physical medium.

2) The Network Layer handles logical addressing (IP addresses) and routing of data packets across different networks.

3) The Transport Layer provides end-to-end communication control, error detection, and flow control using protocols like TCP and UDP.

4) The Session Layer establishes, manages, and terminates connections between applications.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
ओपन सिस्टम्स इंटरकनेक्शन (OSI) संदर्भ मॉडल के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) डेटा लिंक लेयर (Data Link Layer) एक भौतिक माध्यम पर बिट-बाय-बिट ट्रांसमिशन के लिए जिम्मेदार है।

2) नेटवर्क लेयर (Network Layer) लॉजिकल एड्रेसिंग (IP एड्रेस) और विभिन्न नेटवर्कों में डेटा पैकेट की रूटिंग को संभालती है।

3) ट्रांसपोर्ट लेयर (Transport Layer) TCP और UDP जैसे प्रोटोकॉल का उपयोग करके एंड-टू-एंड संचार नियंत्रण, त्रुटि का पता लगाने और प्रवाह नियंत्रण प्रदान करती है।

4) सेशन लेयर (Session Layer) एप्लिकेशन के बीच कनेक्शन स्थापित करती है, प्रबंधित करती है और समाप्त करती है।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is incorrect: Bit-by-bit transmission over a physical medium is handled by the Physical Layer. The Data Link Layer deals with framing, physical addressing (MAC addresses), and hop-to-hop error control.

Statement 2 is correct: The Network Layer uses IP addressing to route packets across intermediate nodes and subnetworks.

Statement 3 is correct: The Transport Layer manages end-to-end communication, segmentation, flow control, and error recovery (TCP/UDP).

Statement 4 is correct: The Session Layer is responsible for opening, closing, and maintaining sessions/dialogues between applications.

Further insights:

Routers operate primarily at Layer 3 (Network Layer), whereas Layer 2 switches operate at the Data Link Layer using MAC address tables.

Hindi:

कथन 1 गलत है: एक भौतिक माध्यम पर बिट-बाय-बिट ट्रांसमिशन को फिजिकल लेयर (Physical Layer) द्वारा नियंत्रित किया जाता है। डेटा लिंक लेयर फ्रेमिंग, फिजिकल एड्रेसिंग (MAC एड्रेस) और हॉप-टू-हॉप त्रुटि नियंत्रण से संबंधित है।

कथन 2 सही है: नेटवर्क लेयर मध्यवर्ती नोड्स और सबनेटवर्क में पैकेट को रूट करने के लिए IP एड्रेसिंग का उपयोग करती है।

कथन 3 सही है: ट्रांसपोर्ट लेयर एंड-टू-एंड संचार, सेगमेंटेशन, प्रवाह नियंत्रण और त्रुटि रिकवरी (TCP/UDP) का प्रबंधन करती है।

कथन 4 सही है: सेशन लेयर एप्लिकेशन के बीच सेशन/संवाद खोलने, बंद करने और बनाए रखने के लिए जिम्मेदार है।

अधिक जानकारी:

राउटर मुख्य रूप से लेयर 3 (नेटवर्क लेयर) पर काम करते हैं, जबकि लेयर 2 स्विच MAC एड्रेस टेबल का उपयोग करके डेटा लिंक लेयर पर काम करते हैं।

questions.question:
Match the following specialized legacy and modern computer hardware PORTS with their core functional interface capabilities:

Port TypeFunctional Capability
1. Parallel Port (IEEE 1284)i. Historically used for low-speed peripherals like mice and modems, transmitting one bit at a time over a single signal line.
2. Serial Port (RS-232)ii. Designed primarily to transmit uncompressed digital video data alongside multi-channel audio over a single interface wire.
3. HDMIiii. Legacy high-speed interface that transfers multiple bits of data simultaneously across parallel physical lines, commonly used for old printers.
4. USB-Civ. Universal, reversible 24-pin interconnect that supports multi-protocol alt-modes, high-speed data, power delivery, and display outputs.

Choose the correct match option:
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित विशिष्ट लिगेसी (legacy) और आधुनिक कंप्यूटर हार्डवेयर पोर्ट्स (PORTS) का उनकी मुख्य कार्यात्मक इंटरफ़ेस क्षमताओं के साथ मिलान करें:

पोर्ट का प्रकार (Port Type)कार्यात्मक क्षमता (Functional Capability)
1. पैरेलल पोर्ट (IEEE 1284)i. ऐतिहासिक रूप से माउस और मॉडेम जैसे कम गति वाले पेरिफेरल्स के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है, जो एक सिंगल सिग्नल लाइन पर एक समय में एक बिट संचारित करता है।
2. सीरियल पोर्ट (RS-232)ii. मुख्य रूप से एक सिंगल इंटरफ़ेस वायर पर मल्टी-चैनल ऑडियो के साथ असंपीड़ित (uncompressed) डिजिटल वीडियो डेटा संचारित करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है।
3. एचडीएमआई (HDMI)iii. लिगेसी हाई-स्पीड इंटरफ़ेस जो समानांतर भौतिक लाइनों में एक साथ डेटा के कई बिट्स स्थानांतरित करता है, आमतौर पर पुराने प्रिंटर के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।
4. यूएसबी-सी (USB-C)iv. यूनिवर्सल, रिवर्सिबल 24-पिन इंटरकनेक्ट जो मल्टी-प्रोटोकॉल ऑल्ट-मोड्स, हाई-स्पीड डेटा, पावर डिलीवरी और डिस्प्ले आउटपुट का समर्थन करता है।

सही मिलान विकल्प चुनें:
questions.solution:
1-iii: Parallel ports sent an entire byte of data at once across 8 distinct pins, which limited cable lengths due to cross-talk interferences.

2-i: RS-232 serial communication sends data sequentially down a single transmission wire, making it slower but highly reliable over longer distances.

3-ii: HDMI (High-Definition Multimedia Interface) replaced multi-cable analog systems with a single consolidated digital display framework.

4-iv: USB-C is a modern hardware standard capable of carrying PCIe, DisplayPort, and Thunderbolt signals via dynamic pin configuration allocation.

Further insights:

USB-C's Power Delivery (PD) specification allows bidirectional power negotiations up to 240W, letting a single port act as a display output, a data pipeline, and a high-voltage charging port at the same time.

Hindi:

1-iii: पैरेलल पोर्ट्स 8 अलग-अलग पिनों के माध्यम से एक ही बार में डेटा का पूरा बाइट भेजते थे, जो क्रॉस-टॉक इंटरफेरेंस के कारण केबल की लंबाई को सीमित करता था।

2-i: RS-232 सीरियल संचार एक सिंगल ट्रांसमिशन वायर के माध्यम से क्रमिक रूप से डेटा भेजता है, जिससे यह धीमा हो जाता है लेकिन लंबी दूरी पर अत्यधिक विश्वसनीय होता है।

3-ii: HDMI (हाई-डेफिनिशन मल्टीमीडिया इंटरफ़ेस) ने मल्टी-केबल एनालॉग सिस्टम को एक सिंगल समेकित डिजिटल डिस्प्ले फ्रेमवर्क के साथ बदल दिया।

4-iv: USB-C एक आधुनिक हार्डवेयर मानक है जो डायनेमिक पिन कॉन्फ़िगरेशन आवंटन के माध्यम से PCIe, DisplayPort और Thunderbolt सिग्नल ले जाने में सक्षम है।

Further insights:

USB-C का पावर डिलीवरी (PD) विनिर्देश 240W तक द्विदिश (bidirectional) पावर नेगोशिएशन की अनुमति देता है, जिससे एक सिंगल पोर्ट एक ही समय में डिस्प्ले आउटपुट, डेटा पाइपलाइन और हाई-वोल्टेज चार्जिंग पोर्ट के रूप में कार्य कर सकता है।

questions.question: In MS Excel, which function searches for a value in the leftmost column of a table array and returns a value in the same row from a specified column number?
questions.question_hi: MS Excel में, कौन सा फ़ंक्शन टेबल ऐरे (table array) के सबसे बाएँ कॉलम में किसी मान को खोजता है और एक निर्दिष्ट कॉलम संख्या से उसी पंक्ति में एक मान लौटाता है?
questions.solution:
=VLOOKUP(lookup_value, table_array, col_index_num, [range_lookup]) performs a vertical lookup by searching for a key in the first column of table_array and retrieving data from the specified column index col_index_num. HLOOKUP searches horizontally along the top row.

Further insights:

INDEX() combined with MATCH() can perform lookups in any direction and is more flexible than VLOOKUP(). XLOOKUP(), available in newer versions of Excel, also removes many limitations of VLOOKUP().

Hindi:

=VLOOKUP(lookup_value, table_array, col_index_num, [range_lookup]) table_array के पहले कॉलम में एक कुंजी (key) की खोज करके और निर्दिष्ट कॉलम इंडेक्स col_index_num से डेटा प्राप्त करके एक वर्टिकल लुकअप (vertical lookup) करता है। HLOOKUP शीर्ष पंक्ति के साथ क्षैतिज रूप से खोजता है।

अधिक जानकारी (Further insights):

MATCH() के साथ संयुक्त INDEX() किसी भी दिशा में लुकअप कर सकता है और VLOOKUP() की तुलना में अधिक लचीला है। Excel के नए संस्करणों में उपलब्ध XLOOKUP() भी VLOOKUP() की कई सीमाओं को दूर करता है।
